shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la docs 2>&1; find docs -type f -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "---"; find docs -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v -i '\.md$' | sort
ls -la docs; find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sort

find docs -mindepth 1 \( -type l -o -name '.*' \) ; find docs -type f | sort | wc -l; find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do h=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | awk '{print $1}'); s=$(stat -f %z "$f"); l=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); printf '%s  %s  %s  %s\n' "$h" "$s" "$l" "$f"; done

find docs -mindepth 1 \( -type l -o -name '.*' \); echo "total files: $(find docs -type f | wc -l)"; shasum -a 256 $(find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sort); stat -f '%z %N' $(find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sort); wc -l $(find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sort)

shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md && stat -f '%z %N' docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs

shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md

wc -lc docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md
